UnitStatement: The equipment-costing-extract skill is invoked with a generic TASK shell and no profile.
ScopePath must point to the top-level domain execution root.
TaskSkill must be equipment-costing-extract and match the skill folder name.
AllowedWriteTargets must be exactly {DOMAIN_ROOT}/_Aggregation/Equipment_Extract/.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH must be an absolute path to a KTY folder containing KA-*.md files.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT must be {DOMAIN_ROOT}/_Aggregation/Equipment_Extract/ and already exist.
RuntimeOverrides.EQUIPMENT_TYPES is a semicolon-delimited target module type list.
Equipment module type matching is case-insensitive.
RuntimeOverrides.EQUIPMENT_EXTRACT_PATH may point to {KTY_ID}_Equipment_Extract.md to enrich Subcomponents.
TaskProfile NONE runs the skill in generic TASK shell mode without a profile.
The output CSV must have exactly 17 columns in the specified order.
The output uses one row per distinct equipment service, not per tag when identical units share a costing basis.
CSV fields containing commas or semicolons must be quoted.
Values stated as pending in the source use TBD.
Values not addressed in the source are left blank.
The skill reads only KA-*.md files, _CONTEXT.md, _REFERENCES.md, and optional Equipment_Extract.md under the specified KTY context.
The skill must not read arbitrary files under ScopePath.
The skill writes only {OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv.
OUTPUT_ROOT must already exist because the skill does not create the directory.
KTY_ID is derived at runtime from _CONTEXT.md or from the folder name.
One invocation processes one KTY folder.
The orchestrator spawns one TASK per relevant KTY for parallel processing.
Equipment module type matching normalizes output to the casing provided in EQUIPMENT_TYPES.
KTYs with zero matches produce a header-only CSV with no data rows.
A valid run confirms KTY_PATH exists and contains at least one KA-*.md file, or reports FAILED_INPUTS.
A valid run confirms OUTPUT_ROOT exists before writing.
A valid run confirms EQUIPMENT_TYPES is non-empty and parseable.
A valid run reads every KA-*.md file in the KTY folder or explicitly reports its absence.
A valid run writes {KTY_ID}_Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv to OUTPUT_ROOT.
A valid run writes or modifies no files in KTY_PATH.
The equipment costing CSV column count must be exactly 17.
The equipment costing CSV column order is fixed by the QA checks.
The equipment costing CSV header row must be present as the first row.
CSV fields containing commas, semicolons, or newlines are quoted.
Every extracted row must name the specific KA file or files used in Source_KA_Files.
Every extracted equipment item must appear in the cited KA file text.
Invented equipment items are prohibited.
Equipment_Tag must exactly match KA source text or Equipment_Extract.md, or use No tag when unstated.
Multiple equipment tags use a comma-space delimiter.
All non-empty specification columns must contain sourced values.
TBD is used for values stated as pending in the source.
Match_Quality must be Exact, Near, or Out_of_Scope.
Equipment_Module_Type must match one of the provided target module types.
Out_of_Scope rows must include a non-blank Description explaining the scope exclusion basis.
A run with untraceable equipment rows or invented parameter values is invalid.
Every target module type in EQUIPMENT_TYPES should be checked against KTY content.
Not every target module type is expected to produce matches in every KTY.
A KTY with zero matches is valid when it produces a header-only CSV.
The run record must state matched module types, unmatched module types, and total row count.
A zero-match KTY still produces a CSV file with the 17-column header row and no data rows.
A zero-match KTY run record states that no matches were found and lists checked target module types.
Extraction issues are grouped by ambiguous match quality, TBD/TBC parameters, scope boundary items, missing parameter data, and subcomponent enrichment gaps.
A clean run reports RUN_STATUS=SUCCESS.
A clean run reports the output file path.
A clean run reports matched equipment count.
A clean run reports module types that matched.
A clean run reports module types with no matches.
A clean run reports KA files read.
A clean run reports no warnings or explicitly states that none were encountered.
The skill frontmatter name is equipment-costing-extract.
The skill is used when building equipment costing registers for cost estimation.
The skill is compatible with Chirality TASK in generic shell mode without a profile.
The skill metadata declares chirality-task-profile NONE.
The skill extracts costing-relevant design basis parameters for equipment items that match a target module type list.
The skill operates on one Knowledge Type folder at a time.
The skill produces a per-KTY CSV file for matched equipment rows.
Matched equipment rows contain capacity, power or duty, size, design conditions, fluid service, subcomponents, and key costing parameters.
The skill is reasoning-first extraction.
The skill reads KA markdown files and applies matching and extraction logic directly.
tools/reporting/merge_equipment_costing_csv.py consolidates per-KTY outputs downstream.
The suitable agent shell is TASK in generic shell mode with no profile.
WORKING_ITEMS dispatches one TASK per relevant KTY for parallel extraction.
ScopePath is a required input and represents the top-level domain execution root.
AllowedWriteTargets is a required input and must be {DOMAIN_ROOT}/_Aggregation/Equipment_Extract/.
RuntimeOverrides.KTY_PATH is a required input pointing to the Knowledge Type folder to extract from.
RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT is a required input pointing to the equipment extract aggregation directory.
RuntimeOverrides.EQUIPMENT_TYPES is a required input listing target equipment module types to match.
An existing Equipment_Extract.md can populate Subcomponents for modular or packaged equipment.
KTY_ID is extracted from _CONTEXT.md or inferred from the folder name.
KTY_PATH must be a valid directory containing KA-*.md files.
OUTPUT_ROOT must be an existing output directory for CSV files.
EQUIPMENT_TYPES must be a semicolon-delimited list of target module types.
EQUIPMENT_EXTRACT_PATH may be a valid file path or omitted.
The read boundary includes all Knowledge Artifact files matching KA-*.md.
The read boundary includes _CONTEXT.md for KTY identity metadata.
The read boundary includes _REFERENCES.md for reference context.
The read boundary includes the existing equipment register when EQUIPMENT_EXTRACT_PATH is provided.
The skill does not read Scoping.md, _STATUS.md, _MEMORY.md, or files outside the KTY folder except optional Equipment_Extract.md.
Writes are limited to {RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv.
The skill uses no deterministic tools during extraction.
The downstream consolidation tool is invoked by the orchestrator, not by this skill.
If KTY_PATH is invalid, the run reports RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
If OUTPUT_ROOT is missing, the run reports RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
If EQUIPMENT_TYPES is empty, the run reports RUN_STATUS=FAILED_INPUTS.
The skill reads _CONTEXT.md on a best-effort basis.
The skill extracts KTY ID, KTY name, parent Category ID, and parent Category name from context.
If _CONTEXT.md is missing or ambiguous, the skill falls back to the folder name.
The skill reads _REFERENCES.md on a best-effort basis for source document context.
The skill lists all KA-*.md files in the KTY folder.
The skill reads KA files in KA-number order.
The skill identifies equipment items whose function or type matches or near-matches target module types.
Exact match applies when the equipment name or type directly corresponds to a target module type.
Near match applies when equipment serves a similar function, is a recognizable variant, or uses another item specification by assumption.
Out_of_Scope applies when equipment is explicitly excluded from DBM scope.
Out_of_Scope rows still require a Description with a brief scope exclusion note.
Items with no match to any target module type are omitted from the output.
For each matched equipment item, the skill extracts values from KA files.
Equipment_Module_Type records the target module type that the item matches.
Match_Quality records Exact, Near, or Out_of_Scope.
Equipment_Instance records the specific equipment name as stated in KA text.
Equipment_Tag records the exact tag from KA source text or Equipment_Extract.md, or No tag when unstated.
When one row covers multiple identical units, Equipment_Tag lists tags with comma-space delimiters.
Quantity_and_Sparing records the sparing philosophy.
Description is a brief functional description of one or two sentences.
Capacity_Throughput records the primary capacity metric with units.
Power_Duty records motor power or thermal duty.
Size_Dimensions records physical dimensions or volume.
Design_Pressure records design pressure or MAWP pressure with units.
Design_Temperature records the design temperature range.
Fluid_Process_Service records service description including sour or sweet service and composition notes.
Subcomponents records semicolon-delimited major sub-items, with N/A for standalone items.
Key_Costing_Parameters records costing factors such as material spec, MAWP, coatings, sour service, area classification, enclosure, code, or VFD.
Source_KTY records the KTY ID.
Source_KA_Files records a comma-delimited list of KA files used.
Notes records match-quality notes, TBD counts, scope notes, and conflicts.
When EQUIPMENT_EXTRACT_PATH is provided and exists, the skill reads Equipment_Extract.md.
For modular or packaged equipment, the skill extracts subcomponent lists from the equipment table.
The skill populates Subcomponents with semicolon-delimited sub-items.
The output CSV includes a header row with all 17 columns.
Identical units sharing a costing basis are merged into one row with quantity in Quantity_and_Sparing.
Units serving distinct locations or services are split into separate rows even if they share an equipment type.
The output CSV quotes fields containing commas, semicolons, or newlines.
KTYs with zero matches write a header-only CSV and report that no matches were found.
The output artifact is {KTY_ID}_Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv in OUTPUT_ROOT.
KTY folders are read-only during the skill run.
Only explicitly stated KA file parameters may be extracted.
Values mentioned as pending use TBD.
Equipment tags must be verbatim from source.
Every KA-*.md file in the folder must be read.
Only equipment matching a target module type is included in the output.
Every output row must cite specific KA source files.
QA expects all KA files in the folder to have been read or their absence reported.
QA expects every CSV row to cite specific KA source files.
QA forbids equipment rows for items not present in KA source text.
QA expects equipment tags to be verbatim from source.
QA expects Match_Quality classification to be correct.
QA expects the CSV to have exactly 17 columns with correct headers.
QA expects no files in KTY_PATH to be written or modified.
After all per-KTY TASK runs complete, the orchestrator consolidates outputs into Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv.
No deterministic tool ordering applies during reasoning-first extraction.
No operational helper tools are declared during extraction.
The downstream merge tool is outside the skill execution scope.
The agent reads _CONTEXT.md and _REFERENCES.md for identity and source context.
The agent reads all KA-*.md files in the KTY folder in order.
The agent applies matching logic to identify equipment corresponding to target module types.
The agent extracts costing-relevant parameters from markdown tables and prose.
The agent optionally reads Equipment_Extract.md for subcomponent enrichment.
The agent assembles and writes the per-KTY CSV output.
Reasoning governs preconditions, context reading, KA enumeration, equipment matching, parameter extraction, CSV composition, and writing.
The skill must not write outside OUTPUT_ROOT.
The skill must not modify any file in KTY_PATH.
The skill must not widen scope beyond the designated KTY folder plus optional Equipment_Extract.md.
The skill must not rely on tools outside the declared list.
The skill must not invent parameter values not stated in KA source text.
The write boundary is {RuntimeOverrides.OUTPUT_ROOT}/{KTY_ID}_Equipment_Costing_Extract.csv.
The skill does not create OUTPUT_ROOT and does not modify KTY_PATH.
